O.outcome_detail: quadratic weighted kappa for five-band difficulty-label agreement

cells.quote: When difficulty is discretized into the five-band scheme of Table 4, the model reaches a QWK of 0.835 against the calibrated labels, whereas MetaMath has a QWK of 0.692 and MathBERT has a QWK of0.625.
cells.note: The study reports a higher QWK for the proposed model than for MetaMath; it does not state an assignment design or learner sample characteristics for this model comparison.
